attributes.residual: MEASURED BUG FOUND AND FIXED DURING VERIFICATION: MWCC emits the exception-table sections UNDOTTED. `objdump -h` on memcard.o shows `extab` and `extabindex`, not `.extab`/`.extabindex`, so an EH_SECTIONS tuple carrying only the dotted spellings would never have fired on the very incident the feature exists for. Both tools now carry both spellings; the live perturbation test above is the proof it fires. Any future section-name matching in this project must assume undotted MWCC section names.

held_fixed: The DATA verdict class ALARMS but does not fail the gate: data movement is score-invisible, so it orders an arbitration (ninja PROGRESS 'Data:' or datadiff --sections) rather than blocking a commit. That choice was held constant so this item cannot turn previously-passing gates red for other lanes mid-run; making it fail-closed is a separate, deliberate decision.

hypothesis.statement: The run-34 TOOL worktree W:/Repositories/GDL-Claude-ToolQueue4 on branch claude/tool-queue-4-20260902 had a SECOND writer implementing the same 11-item queue concurrently. Before any future lane edits a tool file in a provisioned worktree, it should re-grep for the feature it is about to add and re-read the file immediately before each edit, treating 'the file changed on disk since you last read it' as a STOP-AND-CHECK signal rather than a stale-cache warning.
